simple.meaning: דּוּמָה (dûwmâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “silence ; figuratively, death.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דּוּמָה (H1745) before moving outward to related references.
